scope_boundary: Local-first, export-based pilot only. No SaaS, direct ERP connector, audit opinion, compliance certification, or ROI guarantee.

criteria.example_success_signal: Local install and doctor command complete on the agreed pilot machine.
Standard demo and synthetic enterprise demo regenerate without live customer data.
Pilot exports validate or produce understandable mapping gaps.
Reports, evidence binder, review register, and client pack are generated locally.
Pilot users identify useful exceptions, noisy checks, missing fields, and next-step gaps.
No live customer data is shared publicly; retention and deletion decisions are recorded.
